beats.say: David Warner just called the crowd sizes for the South Africa Test match pathetic.
On Tuesday 20 October, Sky Sports reported the former batter's criticism during the second Test.
The Guardian says Temba Bavuma scored 179 runs before being caught by Carey off Mitchell Starc.
The pressure is on because South Africa lost the first Test in Durban by 214 runs.
The Guardian also reports Simon Harmer was bowled by Marnus Labuschagne for 82 runs.
Warner's comments come as South Africa and Australia continue their second men's cricket Test.
Is David Warner right to criticise the South African Test crowds?
